How the time is spent

  1. Thanesar settlement intro 25 min

    Locate regional religious and courtly heritage.

    You: map

  2. Sheikh Chilli tomb precinct 50 min

    Read Mughal-era funerary architecture.

    You: elevation sketch

  3. Associated heritage viewpoints 50 min

    Compare building phases and art.

    You: find motifs

  4. Museum option if open 25 min

    Use gallery objects or printed plate pack.

    You: interpretation worksheet

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Situate Sheikh Chilli Tomb & Thanesar within its regional historical context.
  • Use observable topography and published evidence to test an interpretation.
  • Produce a concise field record with uncertainty clearly identified.
